correctness.rationale: On the equal-boundary-mass two-circle Hardy space, e_n=z^n/√(1+r^{2n}), multiplication by z^k has weights √(V_{n+k}/V_n), V_n=1+e^{-2hn}. Directly expanding [M_{z^l}*,M_{z^k}] gives the exact rational n,k,l band formula in RESULT.md; an independent rational algebra identity test passed 525 mixed-band instances. Each of finitely many bands has O(h²sech²(hn)) envelope, ensuring positivity through the normal boundary extension and S_p membership for every fixed h,p>0. After h^{-2} rescaling the local Fourier band symbol is sech²(t)|φ′(e^{iθ})|². Finite-window closed index walks and Riemann sums give integer moments; uniform spectral approximation plus exponential Schatten-tail bounds yield every fixed positive real p and spectral tests away from zero. ∫sech^{2p}=√πΓ(p)/Γ(p+1/2), so p=1/2 yields 1/2∫|φ′|dθ; slowly localized Fourier packets give ||C||/h²→max|φ′|². Fixed φ and equal boundary weights are essential.
